activities.title: Learning Sounds
activities.content:
Identify Sounds: What Sound Am I Making?
• Say: Nda pumani kёkёs. Mán do ko ndu wejatsär ndu leetsin ko wi ndoona  wi.

another pupil if first was incorrect. Continue with another sound.

activities.title: Writing
activities.content:
Fine Motor Development
• Say: Nja ka liincan intaañ iñan inja ni ngёliaf inja. Ko wi ka tsёnk inja nja ka pican 
uwar.
• The stronger the muscles in our hands, the better we can control our hands when 
writing.
• Exercise is marching: standing in place the opposite arm swings forward to the 
raised knee (left arm and right knee together). As pupils march on the spot, give 
orders: low march knees raised slightly), normal march (knees raised to half 
raised), high march (knees raised as high as possible), left turn, right turn, face 
forward.
• Alternative exercise is the crab walk: (make sure the ground is not dirty so pupils 
do not soil their clothes) sit on the ground with legs extended out in front, place 
hands by ide with fingers pointed toward feet, lift body up into the air, start 
moving forward or backwards. Have pupils try for one minute then have them stop 
and rest for a minute. Then have them try again for another minute.
